notes.title: April Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]April 2025 Development Update[/h1]
As we rocket toward PGDX this July, we're excited to bring you another behind-the-scenes look at what we've been building in HypurrX. 

[previewyoutube=bICpho080M0;full][/previewyoutube]

Expect some fresh concept art drops soon!

[h2]Areas of Focus[/h2]
[list]
[*] Our pilot progression systems are taking shape. Beyond naming and customizing your feline flyer, we want players to develop their pilot's career. Gain experience, unlock gear and enhance your ship and skills with a variety of upgrades.

[*] We're also experimenting with cinematic camera work. We want to allow our animators to develop kick ass cutscenes. But we are also looking at a mix of traditional vertical shoot-em-up action,  and angles to bring added immersion and playstyles to the game. 
This is one of the genre blending initiatives we know we will need to work hard to refine and we're determined to get it right!

[*] Work is underway refining our models and animations to include greater levels of interaction with your ship and enemies.

[*] We are examining the best Steam Shmups, old and new, and going through some great review streams out there. Our team span  generations of gamers, and we know how important it will be to get the combat systems feeling explosive, refined and responsive.

[/list]

[h2]Playtests Starting[/h2]
Finally, we are calling on players and enthusiasts to participate in a closed playtest of our game over the next 8 weeks in the run up to PGDX.
We'll have a dedicated private channel on our discord and will be providing playtest game keys for a limited number of slots.
We are keen to hear feedback and to have players actively help us shape and tune our project.

Playtest Sign-ups will happen right here on discord! More details to follow soon! 

Thanks for everyone's kind words of support!
Let's gooo!
ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]March 2025 News and Development Update[/h1]
..already hurtling through 2025 and we are delighted to bring you some long awaited news of our progress on HypurrX.

[h2]Development Updates[/h2]
Check out our development update video on youtube - giving a glimpse of the action and chaos we have been working on.
[previewyoutube=C_FdhBo6JPo;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*]We are hard at work towards a DEMO for y'all to play!
[*]Our pilot profile screen is coming together allowing you to sign-up your furry friend to join M.E.O.W
[*]The gameplay HUD now features a direct link to your pilot's cam comm link to keep you better connected throughout the action.
[*]The points scoring system is coming together as we begin ramping up the challenges for tournament play.
[*]Your flight suit has been tailored specifically to get you back in the action as you will freefall back into your ship and continue the mission! Make the most of your 9 Lives! 
[/list]
ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

[h2]Concept Art Drops![/h2]
Our first official concept art pack is here! You can see some of the design and ideas going into the game hot off the production line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252544/1ae7568b566c1e3075a8c906da75a7f55fe81942.jpg[/img]
[b]Character Development[/b]
Captain Usui is the skilled but overconfident pilot serving in M.E.O.W (Mach Eight Orbital Watch), tasked with defending the Klaudr Bell Raceway.

Determined, tenacious, and fiercely loyal, he never backs down from a challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252544/e9003bad06e11dd42b6cd107301f1aa0f05459dd.jpg[/img]
[b]M.E.O.W Flight Suit[/b]
As a Captain of the M.E.O.W - Mach Eight Orbital Watch, having the right gear and presence is essential.

The M.E.O.W are the peacekeeping force of the Klaudr Bell, defending it's skies, raceways, and transport routes.
 
Highly trained, precision-flying specialists, adept in high-speed manoeuvres and zero-G combat.

M.E.O.W gear offers protection, agility and a distinctive look to take to the skies in style!
A pilot must be as bold and unshakeable as the machine they fly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252544/7dee9c9a1e388ca3991029adbd8eae1cdd4745b5.jpg[/img]

[b]Join M.E.O.W Now![/b]
The Mach Eight Orbital Watch is looking for the next generation of elite pilots to defend the Klaudr Bell and beyond!

Think you have what it takes? 
M.E.O.W pilots face high-speed skirmishes, gravity-defying manoeuvres, and the toughest enemies in the system. 

Fly Faster. Fight Harder. Become Legends!

🛑 Apply today—only the best make the cut! 🛑

[h2]Other News[/h2]
We were honoured to present our Indie Dev Story for this months MEE Games Indie Dev Meetup and hope to share more of our journey as our development journey goes on.
[url=https://www.facebook.com/share/1BbJJ5Upe6/]MEE Games - Indie Dev Story[/url]

We welcome feedback and thoughts in our community channels and please help our indie project by liking and sharing the content.

More coming soon!
